BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VII
BRANCH: ECE   SESSION : MO/2019

                                      SUBJECT : EC7207 SATELLITE COMMUNICATION SYSTEM

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) Explain  various  frequency  bands  and services  provided  by  satellite  communication
system.
[2]
 (b) Describe  main  advantages  and  disadvantages  of  satellite  communication  system  over
other types of communication system.
[3]


Q2 (a) Give reasons of uplink frequency to be high compared to downlink frequency. [2]
 (b) Explain briefly the orbital parameters required to determine satellite orbit. [3]


Q3 (a) What is sun transit outage?  [2]
 (b) State  and  explain  with  necessary  diagrams  and  equation  the  Kepler’s three  laws  of
planetary motion.
[3]


Q4 (a) A satellite receiver input equivalent temperature is 20k and its  bandwidth is  10 MHz.
Calculate the system noise temperature and noise power if RF temperature is 15k, input
temperature is 40k, IF temperature is 150k, RF gain is 20dB, mixer gain is -15dB and IF
gain is 100dB.
[2]
 (b) Derive the expressions for system noise temperature for amplifiers connected in series. [3]


Q5 (a) What is meant by satellite attitude control and briefly write its type. [2]
 (b) Derive the expression for reliability of a device of system and explain the bathtub curve
very briefly.
[3]


Q6 (a) The beam width required for a geostationary satellite for global coverage is 17
0
. Design
a horn antenna at 3GHz.
[2]
 (b) Draw the block diagram of satellite receiver and explain it. [3]
